title: Git working tree view: dirty files in their own window (read-only)
body:
Per-Project window showing uncommitted changes: staged, unstaged, untracked, colored by status, like the commit details file tree. View only, no stage/commit/push. Reuse the tree from src/git_history/details.rs and the shared git helper (src/git_history/git.rs) from l8th0t. Clicking a file should open the l8th0t diff window (HEAD/index vs working copy).

DEPENDS ON l8th0t (blocked 2026-09-24; l8th0t was still backlog). Start only after l8th0t lands.

Brainstorm decisions (from the human, 2026-09-24):
- Layout: copy the JetBrains "Commit" tool window's change list, in Foreman style, minus everything that writes. Top-level collapsible groups "Changes N files" and "Unversioned Files N files" (untracked), each with a muted file count and a directory tree under it (folder rows with "N files", files colored by status via details.rs status_color). No checkboxes, no commit message box, no Commit/Amend/Push buttons, and no rollback/shelve toolbar actions. A Refresh button is the only toolbar item. Staged vs unstaged is not decided in the screenshot. JetBrains merges them into "Changes"; confirm with the human whether to add a separate "Staged" group or merge them the way JetBrains does.
- Refresh: manual Refresh button, plus a debounced automatic re-read when the window opens or becomes active. No file watcher, no polling, and no work while idle.
- Diff: working-tree diffs are out of scope for l8th0t v1, so this card must add a working-tree DiffTarget kind (index/HEAD vs working copy; untracked = new file).
